root_motivation: Who: the discovery chain's conformance link (and any client that lists resources and expects a name it planted). What: the host's listing shape for resources is undocumented in every machine-readable contract; `contracts/host-tools.v1.json` carries `contract_version`, `kinds`, `output_envelope_fields`, `tools` only (origin/main a91ed505). Why they cannot: the only generated artefact that names the URI templates is `docs/protocol/resources.md` (`mcphost resources-doc`, `src/main.rs:200`), prose no harness ingests. Cost: one full chain run per day reports a red resources family that is a probe-field mismatch, which hides any real listing bug behind it, and the #392 drift test has nothing to drift against, so the next host-side rename of `name` or `title` goes unnoticed until the chain is red again.
user_persona: An agent that calls host.sync.create with a source ref and gets a scheduled mirror in one call; Operator Joe who reads docs/tools.md and llms.txt and knows both were rendered from the SourceKind enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given `RESOURCE_TEMPLATES` at `src/resources.rs`, When `mcphost contract dump` runs, Then `contracts/host-tools.v1.json` carries a top-level `resources` object with `uri_scheme` and `name_field`, each keyed by every template kind, generated by iterating the registry, and a unit test asserts the key set equals the template kind set.

Given the committed `contracts/host-tools.v1.json`, When `mcphost contract dump` runs in a clean checkout, Then its output equals the committed file byte for byte, `resources.uri_scheme.table` is `mcphost://table/{name}` and `resources.uri_scheme.doc` is `mcphost://doc/{id}` as `uri_for` formats them, and `resources.uri_scheme.run` is `mcphost://run/{id}/log` and `resources.name_field.tool` is `tool_spec:{name}`.

Given a `RESOURCE_TEMPLATES` entry whose template string is changed in a test fixture, When `mcphost contract --check` runs against the unchanged committed file, Then it exits non-zero and its output contains the drifted `resources` key.

Given `name_field`, When a table and a doc are listed through `resources/list` in an integration test, Then each listed `name` equals its kind's `name_field` with the placeholder replaced by the same value the listing passed to `uri_for` (`table:{name}` → `table:<name>`, `doc:{id}` → `doc:<ulid>`), and the `uri` equals `uri_scheme` for that kind with the same substitution.

Given a doc resource with a human name, When it is listed, Then the contract's `resources.title_field.doc` is `title` and the listed entry's `title` equals the doc name, while table has no `title_field` entry and no `title`.

Given an HTTP server started in a test with no tenant key, When `GET /contract.json` is requested, Then the body's `resources` object equals the dump's, the response carries the ETag the contract sha defines, and a second request with `If-None-Match` gets 304.

Given a freshly signed-up test tenant with no tables and no docs, When `resources/list` is called with its key and `GET /contract.json` with no key, Then the listing is empty and the contract still carries all `resources` kinds, so the shape is readable before any resource exists.

Given prod after this change deploys, When the contract is fetched anonymously, Then `resources.uri_scheme.table` reads `mcphost://table/{name}` (Live; evidence: `curl -sS https://mcphost.dev/contract.json | jq -e '.resources.uri_scheme.table == "mcphost://table/{name}" and .resources.name_field.doc == "doc:{id}"'`)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred: Live (prod; evidence: curl -sS https://mcphost.dev/contract.json | jq -e on resources.uri_scheme.table and resources.name_field.doc)

scope: src/sync/mod.rs: the SourceKind registry, host.sync.create/list/get/delete/run_now, and the trigger tick's sync pass writing a not_implemented sync_runs receipt.
migrations/0130_syncs.sql: syncs and sync_runs tables; Plan.syncs_max (free 5, pro 50) and the quota_syncs_max, connection_missing and schedule_too_frequent error codes.
www/llms.txt gains a generated Data sync section and docs/tools.md the source.kind enum, both rendered from SourceKind.
non_goals: Fetching rows (the pull PRD); push or conflict handling (the two-way PRD); type inference beyond text columns; any new OAuth flow.

additional.main_database_tables: syncs and sync_runs live in the main database (migration 0130), not a per-tenant file, so the tick's sync pass is one indexed query across tenants.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not keep a host table equal to a sheet?
five_whys_trace.a: No verb registers an external source; the agent would own a puller, a token and a diff loop.
host.table.append cannot update a row and host.trigger.set only calls a published tool.
One SourceKind enum generates the schema, docs and dispatch, so the five kinds cannot drift.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is source.secret?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The NAME of a host.secret (stored as secret_name), never a value, so no secret-named field exists on a Debug struct.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Do push and two_way modes run?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: They are accepted at create with status pending_mode (the PRD default) and the tick skips them.
